file_id: Shyamal Biswas vs Unknown on 17 January, 2023

sentences.text: Shyamal Biswas vs Unknown on 17 January, 2023

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
17.01.2023 Serial no.34 Dd Crm (A) 206 of 2023 In re : An Application for Anticipatory Bail under
Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Belda Police Station Case No. 496
of 2022 dated 05.11.2022 under Sections 498A/323/307/406/34 of the Ipc and sections 3 & 4
Dowry Prohibition Act.

-And- 
In the matter of : Shyamal Biswas ... ...Petitioner Mr. Mrityunjoy Chatterjee Mr. Bhaskar Hutait Mr.
Debapriya Majumder, Advocates ... ...

For the Petitioner Mr. Bidyut Kr. Roy, Ms. Rita Datta ,
Advocate ...
...For the State Petitioner is a Government employee.
Petitioner volunteers to pay one third of his salary to the de facto complainant.
Other co-accuseds were granted anticipatory bail.
In such circumstances, it would be appropriate to direct the police to inform the de facto complainant about the pendency of this application.
Police will not take any coercive action against the petitioner in the meantime.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
